sources.note: CBP Global Entry Mobile app uses facial recognition, not an Apple Wallet card; no official Wallet pass. TSA PreCheck rides on the boarding pass via the KTN.
The physical Global Entry card is required at some land lanes; it is CBP-issued plastic, not a Wallet credential.
2026: TSA PreCheck cannot be added to Apple Wallet as a standalone card; KTN displays on the boarding pass Wallet pass only
